Default.tutorialWhoQuestion: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.
Default.tut1Text: The game has 3 rounds. Everyone draws 9 letter cards — 3 vowels, 3 common consonants, and 3 rare consonants. Make a real word from your letters and submit it within 2 minutes. Turn order follows submission order — the first to submit starts the round.
Default.tut2Text: On your turn, guess a letter (or attempt a Knockout). When a letter is guessed, every player must reveal all occurrences of it in their word. Reveal all of your letters and you are eliminated. The round ends when only one player is left standing.
Default.tut3Text: Instead of guessing a letter, play one of your colored cards to target that player and attempt a Knockout. You must then correctly guess every remaining letter in their word. One mistake and you are eliminated (all your letters revealed); succeed and they are eliminated.
Default.tut4Text: Eliminate a player and you immediately take another turn. Knockouts and extra turns can chain — in theory one player could knock out everyone else in a single streak!
Default.tut5Text: You must discard at least 3 of your letters, which get replaced. Every player always starts a new round with 3 vowels, 3 common consonants, and 3 rare consonants.
Default.tut6Text:
You earn points four ways:
1. the length of the word you submitted
2. +1 for each letter you flip in others' words
3. +1 for each player you knock out
4. by elimination order (1st out = 1 pt, 2nd = 2 pts, and so on). Most points after 3 rounds wins!
Default.tut7Text: If you do not submit a word in time, nothing is submitted for you. If you do not guess a letter or start a Knockout on your turn, a random card from your hand is played for you.
